title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: 1st generation Reels (Akai GX-625)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B)

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording with strong Jerry‑led moments (Stella, They Love Each Other) but an uneven, flat performance overall.
ai_review.review: The SBD source is generally praised for its clarity and crispness, though one reviewer notes muffed patches and a need for heavy EQ in places. Musically the show has highlights – especially the Jerry‑centric jams like Stella and the tender They Love Each Other – but suffers from a tired first set, weak mixes, and an uninspired Space that leaves the energy at a medium level.

ai_rating.rationale: Three enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise the sound and overall enjoyment, while one detailed 2‑star review highlights serious mix and performance issues, leading to an average‑to‑good rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most listeners describe the audio as crisp and great; however, there are reports of muffed patches (e.g., in Truckin'), heavy‑handed EQ needs, and a weak mix early in the set that improves only slightly with matrix sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is described as average to below‑average with flat pacing, while the second set fails to recover, featuring a mix of solid jams and several stilted or ragged moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Searches for better tone in Franklin's Tower; his guitar work shines on strong 'Jer' songs like Stella.
band_member_comments.Phil: Absent early, goes off‑script during Space and is barely audible later in the set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Adds drama‑vocals throughout (notably on Good Lovin') and contributes slide practice moments.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboards are highlighted as a key element during the strong Jerry jam.
